system.description:
When you **_go off a-wandering_**, hold 1 Enigma if you're gone for days, 2 if you're gone for weeks, or 3 if you're gone for months. At the very start of play, hold 3 Enigma. Spend Enigma 1-for-1 to:

- return from your wandering exactly when and where you are needed, fully Outfitted
- Know Things as if you rolled a 10+
- have What You Need to produce an oddly specific yet mundane item of Value 1 or less
